sloka: यदि भर्तुः प्रियम् कार्यम् लोकस्य भरतस्य च ।वृशम्से पापसम्कल्पे क्षुद्रे दुष्कृतकारिणि ॥२-१२-६०॥
transliteration: yadi bhartuḥ priyam kāryam lokasya bharatasya ca ।vṛśamse pāpasamkalpe kṣudre duṣkṛtakāriṇi ॥2-12-60॥

translations.english: O cruel one, O woman of sinful resolve, O vile (creature), O woman of evil deeds, what wrong or sin do you really see in Rama or in me.
